title: Scriptorium Paper Handoff (v1, currently handoff/1.1)
description: Metadata sidecar (meta.json) staged next to one or more papers when handing a report from the library (Steward `pick`) to a downstream consumer such as Lectern (slides generation). One directory per handoff: <staging>/<key>/{<file>.pdf, meta.json}. Single-paper (1.0): the top-level fields ARE the paper. Multi-paper (1.1): `papers[]` lists the sources and the top-level `title` is the report title; `report_type` says whether it is a literature or experiment report. 1.1 is additive — a 1.0 package validates unchanged.

report_type.description: 1.1: kind of report. Optional; defaults to literature.

title.description: Single-paper: the paper title. Multi-paper: the report title.

pdfFilename.description: Filename of the staged PDF (single-paper form).

papers.description: 1.1 multi-paper form. Each item is one source paper staged in the same directory. When present, the top-level fields describe the report, not a paper.
